senses.example: Mi tío vive en el pueblo.
senses.exampleGloss: My uncle lives in the village.

alternatives.reason: Plural often means the couple together, not just uncles.
The colloquial Peninsular sense of tío for a person; not the family sense at all.

notes: Accent on the i: tío. Colloquially tío can mean a bloke in Spain, but only the family sense is taught.
